start.welcome: Hi {name}! I'm Pot Bot. I track your FPL league's weekly pot, check Telebirr payments and post the results. I never hold or send money. Send /help to see how it works.
help.text:
How Pot Bot works
Each gameweek, everyone pays the entry fee to the coordinator on Telebirr. The highest score after transfer hits wins the pot, and the winner and runner-up both skip the next fee. The coordinator collects the money, so their own fee is counted automatically. Pot Bot keeps track and checks payments, but it never holds or sends money.

What to do
1. Tap Claim my team in the group, press Start and pick your team. Do this once.
2. Before the deadline, send the fee to the coordinator on Telebirr.
3. Send your Telebirr screenshot to me in private, or post it in the group and mention {bot}.

If you don't pay by the deadline, you can't win that gameweek, and you owe nothing for it. If I can't confirm a screenshot, the coordinator checks it.

Commands
/status: who has paid, the pot and the time left
/owe: what you owe, and who to send it to (in private)
/table: this gameweek's scores and the overall table
/awards: last gameweek's awards
/app: open the dashboard, results and ledger
/me: your season and what I know about you (in private)
/predict: vote on who wins this gameweek, for bragging rights
/roast: roast last gameweek's lowest scorer, or reply to someone or add their @username
/nofun: stop being roasted
/help: this message

Owner or coordinator? Send /admin for your commands. To start a league, a group admin sends /setup <league link> in the group.
admin.text:
Commands for the owner and coordinator

Payouts
/payout: then send the Telebirr screenshot, and the group is told the pot was delivered
/paidout <gameweek> <team ID> [transaction]: record a payout without a screenshot

Payments
/settelebirr <name>: the name payments must go to
/markpaid <team ID>: record cash or another payment
/markunpaid <team ID>: undo a payment

Results
/override: correct a score or name a winner

League
/setup <league link>: link this group to an FPL league
/coordinator: reply to someone to make them coordinator
/rules: show the league's rules
/setrule <name> <value>: change a rule
/link <team ID>: reply to someone to link them to a team
/unlink <team ID>: remove a link

Fun
/fact <team ID> <text>: tell me something about someone
/persona <name> [spice 1-5]: choose my voice
